pages.text: Use a Radioactive Prism on a frame of Blue Metal Blocks to make a portal to this dimension of endless factory machinery. Hope you like big dungeons, the one here is over 180 blocks long. Miniature horses not included.

pages.title: Obtaining the prism
pages.text: Radioactive Prisms drop from Guardbots in Cyberland, the mob is rare so you may need to search around a bit to find one
